lines.coptic: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲕϩⲏ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡⲉⲕϩⲟ: Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϯϣⲓⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.

translations.english: We follow You with all our hearts, and fear You, and we seek Your face, O God do not forsake us.

transliterations.english: Tenoweh ensok khen penheet teerf: tenerhoti khatekhee: o-woh tenkoti ensa pekho: Efnoti empertishipi nan.

sung.english: We follow You with all our hearts, and we fear You, and we seek Your face, O God do not forsake us.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲏⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ.

translations.english: But rather deal with us, according to Your meekness, and according to Your great mercy, O Lord help us.

transliterations.english: Alla arioui neman: kata tekmetepikees: nem kata epashai ente peknai: Epshois arivo-eethin eron.

lines.coptic: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲏⲃ: ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲑⲟ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛϭⲗⲓⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲱⲓⲗⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲉⲛⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ.

translations.english: May our prayers ascend to You, O our Master, like burnt offerings of lambs, and fat calves.

transliterations.english: Mare teneprosevshee Penneeb: i e-epshoi empekemtho: emefreeti enhanchlil ente hanoili: nem hanmasi evkeni-oout.

sung.english: May our prayers ascend unto You, O our Master, like burnt offerings of lambs, and fatted calves.

lines.coptic: Ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣⲡⲱⲃϣ ⲛ̀ϯⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ: Ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ Ⲓ̀ⲥⲁⲁⲕ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ: Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲕ.

translations.english: Do not forget the covenant, which You have made with our fathers, Abraham Isaac and Jacob, Israel Your saint.

transliterations.english: Empererpovsh entithiatheekee: thee-etaksemneets nem nenioti: Abra-am Isa-ak Yakob: Pisraeel pe-ethowab entak.

sung.english: Do not forget the covenant, which You have made with our fathers, Abraham Isaac and Jacob, Israel Your holy one.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛⲓⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲓⲁⲥⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Bless the Lord all you nations, the tribes and all kinds of tongues, praise Him and glorify Him, above all forever.

transliterations.english: Esmou e-epshois nilaos teerou: nifilee niaspi enlas: hos erof ma-oou naf: arihowo chasf sha ni-eneh.

lines.coptic: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ: Ⲥⲉⲇⲣⲁⲕ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲕ Ⲁⲃⲇⲉⲛⲁⲅⲱ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: Pray to the Lord on our behalf, O three saintly children, Sedrach Misach and Abednego, that He may forgive us our sins.

transliterations.english: Tovh emepshois e-ehree egon: o pishomt enalou enagios: Sedrak Misak Abdenagho: entefka nennovi nan evol.
